summary.text: Gloria Romero Roses is the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 113 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent.
She is managing partner at Nexus Homes, a firm focused on bringing new investment into South Florida's assisted living developments.

paragraphs.text: Roses attended South Broward High School and Florida International University and earned an MBA from the University of Miami.
Ballotpedia describes her as managing partner at Nexus Homes.
Roses sought the Democratic nomination for the U.S. House in Florida's 26th District in 2012 and was defeated by Joe Garcia in the August 14, 2012 primary.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for state House District 113 on August 18, 2026.
